title: Add the ban on source-text and source-shape tests to the testing skill and the review lens
outcome: Use one shared testing rule for observable behavior and have reviewers flag tests that measure implementation text or shape.
acceptance: Step 2 of the coder-test-execution skill, as loaded by Codex and Claude, ends with the exact sentence agreed by both coordinators, byte-identical to TermAl’s counterpart.
The testing review lens adds the agreed source-shape bullet immediately after the existing text-pinning bullet. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md stay unchanged.
The Markdown change passes the focused launcher’s link check and is reviewed by both independent reviewers on the same frozen input.
